C0249.title: Zhang and Sun Operate Aggregation Apps Using Pirate Links to Disseminate Audiovisual Works
keywords: right to network dissemination of information
C0249.summary: In a 2025 intellectual-property protection typical case, the Supreme People’s Procuratorate disclosed that Zhang, Sun, and others operated aggregation apps including “Yingshi Daquan Pure Edition” and “Today Video” from late 2017 to January 2023. Without authorization, they distributed more than 83,000 audiovisual works through hotlinking, downloading, and uploading, earning over RMB 392 million in advertising revenue. In June 2024, Wuxi Xinwu Court convicted Zhang and Sun of copyright infringement, sentencing Zhang to five years and six months plus an RMB 20 million fine, Sun to three years plus an RMB 4 million fine, and other defendants to prison terms and fines and ordered recovery of illegal proceeds and advertising income.
